faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a relevant area. A background in Communications/Signal Processing is also required, with minimum marks from graduation onwards and in 10th and 12th classes.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position ranges from Rs. 72,000 to Rs. 84,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a selection test.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis are also welcome to apply for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IP/10132/Adv/0309 DATED 02.09.2026.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position is contractual.
